reserveReview.rationale: September 30, 2026 14:00 UTC book only: Moore obtained directly from Absa a current-account statement showing ZAR 8,402,400.83 in Super Money SA's name. Issued supply is 8,177,042, with 1,471,220.015722 designated non-circulating by management across Internal Treasury, DeFi Vault and VALR Corporate Account. Management allocates ZAR 1,471,220.02 of reserves to those balances, leaving ZAR 6,931,180.81 against 6,705,821.984278 circulation. The reported 103.36% coverage is scoped to that management-defined circulation, not current whole-token liabilities. Bank-level segregation of the allocation was not independently established. The ISRS 4400 (Revised) engagement expresses no assurance opinion.
